glosses: estate, manor, hall, property (a manor house)
land granted by the state, originally temporarily (e.g. for life), in exchange for military or civil service

examples.text: У него есть поместье за городом.
examples.en: He has an estate in the country.
My aunt inherited the huge estate.

examples.text: Они оценили это поместье в триста тысяч долларов.
examples.en: They've put the value of the estate at three hundred thousand dollars.

examples.text: Моя шестидесятилетняя тётка унаследовала огромное поместье.
examples.en: My sixty-year-old aunt inherited the huge estate.
